subject: 2026 Goals and Bicycle Infrastructure Planning
overview: The Commission established its mission statement and five core goals for 2026 while reviewing local infrastructure projects and regional cycling events. Key decisions included approving bike rack distribution sites and requesting the preservation of a cycling path near a proposed Tufts University development.

items.title: Minutes and Guest Introductions
items.summary: Approved the February 2026 minutes and heard introductions from representatives of the city of Everett and Pedalheads Bike Camps.

items.title: Announcements and Correspondence
items.summary: Noted several upcoming regional bike rides and reviewed a request for feedback regarding e-bike nomenclature and safety terminology.

items.title: Pedalheads Partnership Presentation
items.summary: Discussed potential collaboration with Pedalheads for youth bike camps, including tabling at community events and co-sponsoring safety kit giveaways.

items.title: North of Boston Coalition Bike Ride
items.summary: Reviewed plans for a multi-city coalition bike ride on May 31 connecting Cambridge to Lynn and discussed Medford's role in the event.

items.title: Bike Month and Event Planning
items.summary: Discussed partnering with Bike to the Sea or other local organizations for May events due to limited internal volunteer capacity.

items.title: Playstead Road and Pump Track Updates
items.summary: Received updates on short-term pedestrian improvements at the Playstead Road rail crossing and a pending support letter for a bike pump track.

items.title: Tufts Boston Avenue Advisory Group
items.summary: Reported on the first meeting of the advisory group, noting receptiveness to bike safety improvements and potential budget for raised crosswalks.

items.title: Tufts Aquatic Center Path
items.summary: Approved a motion to write a letter to Tufts University requesting the formalization and maintenance of a key cycling path connection near the proposed Aquatic Center.

items.title: Budget and Website Updates
items.summary: Noted a request for a $700 budget increase for conference attendance and reviewed efforts to update the commission’s online events calendar.

items.title: 2026 Goals and Mission Statement
items.summary: Presented a revised mission statement and five strategic goals focused on inter-agency collaboration, infrastructure, and safety policies.

items.title: Mystic River Rotary
items.summary: Noted that a letter with redesign sketches for the rotary was sent to the Department of Conservation and Recreation.

items.title: Bike Rack Installation Sites
items.summary: Approved the distribution of 15 new bike racks equally between the Boston Avenue corridor, Salem Street, and Main Street.

items.title: Safety Equipment and Member Resignation
items.summary: Discussed ongoing fundraising for bike lights and helmets and accepted the resignation of member Anna Rankert.
